column1: # Ori and the Will of the Wisps, 1.2.1 (v196608), SDK 9.4.0, NVN. Unity 2018.4.24f1 IL2CPP.
# Community run by dusk-beep, 2026-11-25: this profile with #581, #585, #562 and #590 merged (nx2android 0.4.0), POCO X3 Pro (Snapdragon 860 /
# Adreno 640, 6 GB, Android 13), Turnip Mesa 27.0.0-devel. Played from the opening through the wolf fight to the first ability: about 13 minutes,
# 18,995 frames, 59 save commits, 0 'not in the bundle' shaders (142 before #590), one [RED] line (an audio stall at boot), footprint about 1.8 GB.
# 36-39 fps in the menus, 18-31 fps in play; GPU-bound at 1600x900 (long frames 33-100 ms of GPU). Handheld mode gave the same frame rate.
# Rewrite failures at main+0x1b56540 and +0x1b574e0: fixed with nxnative's tail-call proofs.
# Startup race (random crash at boot, main+0x3e540, seen again by the tester): nxnative's registry_lock needs STUBS, which patch_nso.py does not
# load, so it is not applied. See README.md.

column2: v196608 POCO X3 Pro (Snapdragon 860, Adreno 640, Android 13), community test
